test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of P and Q in an alloy is 3: 7. If the alloy is made of only P and Q, how much amount of Q will be there in 1800 kg of that alloy?
solution:
**Given:**

Total weight of alloy = 1800 kg

The ratio of P and Q in an alloy is 3: 7

**Concept used:**

Amount of P = {P/(P + Q)} × Total alloy

or Amount of Q = {Q/(P + Q)} × Total alloy
